mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors adjust valuations to lower risk-free rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has increased by over 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 2 months indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have declined by more than 1% in the past 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as higher interest rates reduce corporate profitability and equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 2 months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has declined by over 2% in 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high consumer confidence (RSAFS > 500000 million dollars), the S&P 500 tends to outperform as strong retail sales support corporate earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months indicates a tightening labor market, which typically supports corporate hiring and wage growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decreases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tight monetary policy during a strong labor market, which typically leads to a sell-off in equities due to rising borrowing costs and potential earnings pressure, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen and UNRATE has fallen in the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
